raw_sections.experience:
Employment Details
iNova Software Services Bangalore Aug 2025 – Till Date Senior Data Engineer
Developed complex SQL procedures, views, and functions for business-critical applications. • Designed normalized and dimensional data models for OLTP and OLAP systems. • Supported Power BI and SSAS models for enterprise reporting.
Qentelli Solutions Pvt. Ltd., Hyderabad Oct 2020 – June 2025 Senior Software Engineer
Developed and optimized database schemas,3NF, stored procedures, triggers, and views. • Designed multi-tenant data models with tenant isolation and scalable growth strategies. • Optimized data models for high-volume transactional systems and large-scale reporting workloads. • Implemented slowly changing dimensions (SCD Type 1 & 2) for analytical and warehouse models • Designed models supporting role-based access control (RBAC), column-level security, masking, and encryption.
Perform metadata analysis, including entity/attribute naming, definitions, data types, lengths, and lineage. • Involved in performance tuning, query optimization, and database monitoring. • Work in Agile, cross-functional teams to design and deliver high-quality data solutions.
DigiConnectt Technologys Pvt. Ltd., Bangalore July 2017 – April 2020
Database Developer
Designed Conceptual, Logical, and Physical Data Models for OLTP and OLAP systems based on business requirements.
• Built lookup and reference tables to standardize master data and reduce redundancy. • Act as a bridge between business and IT teams, ensuring clarity and alignment throughout the SDLC. • Created and maintained data dictionaries, metadata, and ER diagrams for documentation and governance. • Solid understanding of SDLC and Agile methodologies.
Developed and normalized database designs for CRM and VFM platforms.
TechVerve Solutions Pvt. Ltd., Bangalore
June 2015 – June 2017
Software Engineer
Designed Conceptual, Logical, and Physical Data Models for OLTP and OLAP systems based on business requirements.
Translated complex business rules into normalized (3NF) relational schemas with clear entity relationships. • Defined primary keys, surrogate keys, foreign keys, and constraints to ensure data integrity and consistency. • Own and produce data modeling and analysis artifacts to support development teams.
Visionet Systems Pvt. Ltd., Bangalore Oct 2013 – Dec 2014 Associate
Created and maintained schematics for Oil Gas industry projects.

Trigger based auto- matic ticket creation and configurable two-way communication with other tools. Improved intelligence in healing tests on their own and Deliver world class digital experiences by validating your applications using reliable automation tests.
